name: Platinum the Trinity
original_name: トリニティ＝グラスフィール
source:
Hobbies: Othello
Likes: [url=/c34157]Beast-like samurai[/url]
Dislikes: Snakes, [url=/c25638]that guy[/url] who always hangs around beast-like samurai 

Platinum the Trinity is a girl who has three souls. She became a playable character starting with Continuum Shift II. A young girl with three souls named Luna, Sena, and [url=/c30636]Trinity Glassfille[/url]. Luna is a rude young girl who hates women with big breasts; Sena is a polite young boy who is always trying to calm down Luna; and Trinity is the spirit of one of the Six Heroes. Trinity's personality is locked within her Nox Nyctores, and she is only able to come to the surface for brief periods of time. This Nox Nyctores' full name is Arma Reboare: Muchourin, a staff which has the power to incarnate matter.

Platinum normally prefers to avoid violence and lives in the ruins of 5th Hierarchical City of Ibukido, but came to the 13th Hierarchical City of Kagutsuchi by request of Jubei in order to awaken [url=/c26481]Bang's[/url] Phoenix: Rettenjou. Platinum is seen watching over Ragna the Bloodedge, who is with Jubei all the time. Luna is very fond of Jubei, but harbors a deep hatred towards Ragna, most likely due to his connection with Jubei. Finally, Luna gets greatly irritated when Bang tells her that he will do anything to seduce [url=/c25740]Litchi[/url], claiming that he is only interested by her breasts.

[spoiler]This Platinum was actually created to become Trinity's new vessel, however, before that Jubei found the two orphans, Luna and Sena from a research facility. For some reason, the two were still alive but their bodies were not capable of holding their souls in anymore. Instead of using it for herself, Trinity fused their souls together into the vessel and remained a ghost, tagging inside the Muchourin. Both Luna and Sena have always been aware of the third personality, Trinity herself as well.[/spoiler]
